Customize how you appear on other people's devices when you call - **Live Voicemail** - See a live transcription as someone leaves a message and pick up the call *(iPhone 12 and later)* **💬 Messages** - **Stickers iMessage app** - All your stickers in one place (Live Stickers, Memoji, Animoji, emoji stickers, third-party packs) - **Live Stickers** - Create stickers by lifting subjects from photos/videos with effects like Shiny, Puffy, Comic, Outline - Live Voicemail - Check In - FaceTime calls on Apple TV - StandBy (Note: StandBy is also restricted on iPhone XR/XS due to Always-On Display requirements; iPhone 12 supports it fully) **Exceptions for iPhone 12:** - **Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, Conversational Awareness** (AirPods features) - require AirPods Pro (2nd generation), not the iPhone model - **Crash Detection optimizations** - require iPhone 14 and later The iPhone 12 supports the vast majority of iOS 17 features, with the noted exceptions being device-specific hardware limitations rather than software compatibility issues.
